title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-09
source: Soundboard->Cassette Master(MA-R90/Dolby B)->1st Generation Cassette(XLII-S90/Dolby C).1st Generation Cassette->Fostex D5 (pass-through only)->ZA2->Samplitude v7.02 Professional->.wav->mkw->SHN. Transfer, editing, and SHN by Joe Samaritano

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy 10/9/82 show with a smoking Morning Dew, Estimated→Eyes and the On The Road Again > Beat It On Down The Line transition.
ai_review.review: The Frost Amphitheatre performance is remembered for its sunny California vibe and a setlist that keeps rolling like a Swiss watch—standout moments include a soaring Morning Dew, an inspiring Estimated into Eyes pairing, and a tight On the Road Again → Beat It On Down The Line segue. The SBD source is generally clean, though listeners note a slightly windy mix and the odd absence of Bob’s rhythm guitar in the balance.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating ~4.44 with uniformly enthusiastic comments about both performance and recording; technical quirks are minor compared to overall excellence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clean SBD with limited cassette‑gen hiss; a bit windy and slightly loud in places, and Bob’s rhythm guitar is noticeably low or missing in the mix.

standout_songs: On the Road Again > Beat It On Down The Line
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set rolls smoothly with tight transitions; second set offers unusual pairings (e.g., T‑Stones → Touch) and maintains high momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Powerful, emotional lead playing; his leads are highlighted and praised.
band_member_comments.Phil: Energetic bass windup into GSET; crowd‑pleasing and zesty performance.
band_member_comments.Bob: Rhythm guitar is largely missing from the mix, though his presence is noted by fans in the audience.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums sound fine; no specific issues mentioned.
